subject: MAP & procurement path for Helios Labs private offers
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <procurement@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & procurement path for Helios Labs private offers

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a recommended mutual action plan (MAP) and procurement path for accepting private offers on AWS and Azure, plus the billing/invoice flow for Finance. The attached spreadsheet is a draft timeline with stakeholder owners and acceptance gates.

High level ask from you: can the legal/finance folks confirm the preferred PO wording and whether Helios will accept an AWS Private Offer or prefers an Azure Private Offer (or both)? That choice affects invoice timing and when we can push the private-offer links.

What I attached: redwood-map-helios-v1.xlsx — MAP with milestones; po-template.pdf — suggested PO language; azure-private-offer-instructions.txt — brief steps for Azure private offers.

Next steps I propose:
- Your procurement provides PO wording and target approval date (row 2 in the sheet) — due 2025-10-20
- We provision the AWS private offer and share the acceptance link (if AWS chosen) — target 2025-10-22
- Finance sends invoice once the private-offer is accepted (we can also invoice via DocuSign if preferred)

I copied Grace (customer success) to coordinate onboarding milestones and Karthik (Marketplace) for the private-offer activation. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff to walk the MAP live.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Attachment(s): redwood-map-helios-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), po-template.pdf (pdf), azure-private-offer-instructions.txt (text)

From: Alex Moreno <procurement@helioslabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Rivera <ceo@helioslabs.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement path for Helios Labs private offers

Jordan —

Appreciate the draft. Quick answers from procurement/legal side:
- We prefer to accept an AWS Private Offer for initial purchase; we may add Azure later but want single-cloud billing to start.
- PO wording: we'll need Redwood's legal name and the SaaS description line included; I'll paste the redlined clause by EOD 2025-10-17.
- Invoice timing: Helios prefers a single invoice on acceptance with Net 30. If you can generate an invoice triggered by private-offer acceptance, that works best.

Can you confirm whether AWS private-offer acceptance will immediately generate an invoice from Redwood, or if Finance on your side needs a signed PO first? If the latter, we'll push a signed PO the same day we accept.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Procurement
Helios Labs
procurement@helioslabs.com

---
Attachment(s): none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <procurement@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement path for Helios Labs private offers

Alex —

Short answer: we can support both flows, but AWS private-offer acceptance is the smoothest for immediate invoicing. Our recommended path (per MAP tab "Preferred flow"):
1) Helios signs/returns the PO to procurement@redwood.com OR accepts AWS private offer link. Either action will let Finance issue an invoice; acceptance of the AWS private offer automatically notifies our billing system and can generate an invoice immediately.
2) If you choose the PO-first route, please use the attached po-template.pdf language and send signed PO to finance@redwood.com; Finance will issue invoice within 1 business day after receipt.

I've updated the MAP spreadsheet with two parallel tracks (AWS-first and PO-first) and annotated the gating criteria. See attached v1 -> v1.1 (sheet named "Flow options").

If AWS it is, Karthik will provision the offer and send the acceptance link. If PO-first, Soojin will coordinate invoice issuance.

Proposed dates (updated):
- PO redline from Helios: 2025-10-17 (you mentioned EOD)
- Redwood to provision AWS private offer: 2025-10-20
- Target acceptance + invoice generation: 2025-10-22
- Onboarding kickoff (CS): 2025-10-27

I'll stand by to help the legal wording.

Best,
Jordan

---
Attachment(s): redwood-map-helios-v1.xlsx (updated), po-template.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <procurement@helioslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & procurement path for Helios Labs private offers

Forwarding updated activation plan — I will start provisioning the AWS private offer today. Quick notes for the team:
- I'll provide the AWS private-offer link by EOD 2025-10-20. That link includes the price/commit and will trigger our billing workflow once Helios accepts.
- For Azure, we need a separate intake and a marketplace publisher ticket; suggest we keep Azure as a follow-on workstream (no blockers for AWS acceptance).
- Finance action: Soojin, please prepare an invoice template that can be auto-generated on private-offer acceptance and ensure Net 30 terms and the PO number field are present.

Alex — we'll send the AWS link to the procurement email and also copy Sasha to make acceptance visible to execs.

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Invoice & PO handling for Helios Labs purchase

Alex / team —

Thanks — quick confirmation from Finance side: we can auto-generate the invoice upon AWS private-offer acceptance with Net 30. The invoice will include: Redwood legal entity, Redwood tax ID, purchase amount, Helios PO number (if you provide it), and payment instructions (ACH/wire).

If you prefer a signed PO first, we will still issue the invoice the same day we receive the PO. To avoid delays, please include the PO number in the acceptance form or as part of the email when you accept.

I'll attach the invoice template after Jordan shares the final quantity/pricing; for now I'm attaching a sample PDF (po-template.pdf) that matches the required fields.

Soojin Lee
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
